components.name: Button
components.summary: A button, or a link that looks like one when it has an `href`.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Buttons joined together. It needs a label, because a group is a landmark for assistive technology.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A two-state button. It is a checkbox underneath, so it posts with its form, keeps its state with no script and has the keyboard of a checkbox.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.summary: A group of toggles that post as one field.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: A button and the menu it opens.

components.name: Field
components.summary: A control with its label, help and error, tied together with `for`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A single-line input.

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: An input with something fixed before or after it.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A multi-line input. It grows with its text where the browser can.

components.name: NativeSelect
components.summary: The browser's `<select>`.

components.name: Select
components.summary: One choice from a small, fixed list, in a styled listbox.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: One choice, found by typing. The options are in the page, or searched on the server.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.summary: Many choices, shown as chips with a 4 px corner.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A checkbox.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on and off switch: a checkbox with the `switch` role.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: One choice out of several, shown: a `fieldset` of native radios, whose keyboard is the browser's.

components.name: PhoneInput
components.summary: A phone number input with a country picker.

components.name: Forms
components.summary: Draws a `Form`: a `<form>` that posts with or without the runtime.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: A calendar: one or more months, with the days that can be chosen.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: A date field with a calendar.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.summary: A range of days from two dates: one button, and a popover with presets beside a calendar of two months.

components.name: TimePicker
components.summary: A time of day: hours and minutes, and seconds if asked.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A surface for related content.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A short label beside something.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A picture of a person: an image, or a neutral icon when there is none. There is no way to put initials in it.

components.name: Item
components.summary: A row with a title, a description, and things at either end.

components.name: Heading and Text
components.summary: A heading. The level is the document's, the look follows it.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A key on the keyboard.

components.name: Attachment
components.summary: A file shown as a small tile.

components.name: Message and Bubble
components.summary: A message in a conversation: who, when, and bubbles.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Events on a rail.

components.name: ActivityFeed
components.summary: What people did lately, newest first.

components.name: FactCard and FactGrid
components.summary: One fact about something: a small label, a value and the details under it.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A message inside the page.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A message that goes by itself.

components.name: Empty
components.summary: What a list shows when it has nothing in it.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a list, a table or a region shows when it has nothing in it, with the action each case needs. Built on the same markup as the error states.

components.name: ErrorPage
components.summary: A whole page for an error status: the headline, the explanation, what to do next and a reference for support.

components.name: Forbidden
components.summary: "You don't have access to this": the state for a place the user may not see, for a card, a tab, a region or a table row. It never says whether the thing exists.

components.name: NotFound
components.summary: "We can't find that": the state for a record, a card or a region that isn't there.

components.name: SignInRequired
components.summary: The state for a card, tab or region that needs a signed-in user: a button to the sign-in page that brings the user back to where they were.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: How far along something is: the browser's `<progress>`.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: A placeholder while content loads.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A sign that something is happening, named for assistive technology.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog: the browser's `<dialog>`, which brings the focus trap, Esc, focus return and the inert page behind it.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.summary: A dialog that must be answered: `alertdialog`, no close button, and a click outside doesn't dismiss it. Esc still cancels, as APG asks.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: A dialog that slides in from an edge.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: A dialog that rises from the bottom, for phones.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A popup with a click-outside and Esc dismissal, from the browser's `popover`, opened by a button.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short description on hover and on focus, with the `tooltip` role.

components.name: HoverCard
components.summary: A popup on hover or focus with more about a link. Sighted mouse users get it; the same content must be reachable another way.

components.name: Stack, Row, Grid and Container
components.summary: Items one above the other.

components.name: SplitPane
components.summary: Panes with separators between them.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Sections that open and close: `<details>`, whose keyboard is the browser's. With `exclusive`, one open at a time through `name`.

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: One section that opens and closes.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.summary: A scrolling region with thin scrollbars, reachable by keyboard.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A line between things.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.summary: Content held to a shape. The ratios are a closed set because the content security policy allows no `style` attribute.

components.name: Direction
components.summary: Sets the reading direction of what's inside.

components.name: App shell
components.summary: The app's one shell definition. Register it as a provider so `AppShell` can find it.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A list of tabs and their panels.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Where this page sits: a list of links, ending in the current page.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Links between the pages of a list.

components.name: Command
components.summary: A command palette: a modal dialog with a search box and a list of groups of items, opened by `Ctrl` or `Cmd` and `K`.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: The steps of a task, in order.

components.name: Wizard
components.summary: A form in steps.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A slider, single or a range.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: A tree.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: A toolbar.

components.name: Table
components.summary: A table of data. The wrapper scrolls on narrow screens.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: A table with search, filters, sort links, selection and pagination, as one region.

components.name: LazyList
components.summary: A list that loads as it is read, in pages, by cursor. See the module's docs.

components.name: Stat and Bars
components.summary: One figure and what it is.

components.name: Sortable
components.summary: Lists whose items move, within a list and between lists.

components.name: Foundations
components.summary: A control's size.

components.name: Themes
components.summary: A theme: an id, a name and a `ThemeSpec`. The built-in ones are associated constants; `Theme::custom` makes your own.

components.name: Theme builder

components.name: Flags

/// An order, as the table shows it. Each column says what a reader can do with
/// it; the server runs the search, the filters, the sort and the pages.
#[derive(Clone, TableRow)]
#[table(
    cursor,
    capped = 10000,
    sort = "-placed_on",
    per = 25,
    per_pages(10, 25, 50, 100)
)]
pub struct OrderRow {
    #[col(skip)]
    pub id: i64,
    #[col(sortable, search, sticky, label = "Order")]
    pub number: String,
    #[col(search, hidden)]
    pub customer: String,
    #[col(search, hidden)]
    pub email: String,
    // A relation's choices come from the page: each status with how many hold it.
    #[col(sortable, filter = relation)]
    pub status: String,
    #[col(filter = multi, options = FULFILMENTS)]
    pub fulfilment: String,
    #[col(filter = multi, options = PAYMENTS, hide_on_mobile)]
    pub payment: String,
    #[col(sortable, numeric)]
    pub total: i64,
    #[col(skip)]
    pub refunded: i64,
    #[col(filter = multi, options = STATES, hide_on_mobile, label = "Ships to")]
    pub state: String,
    #[col(skip)]
    pub country: String,
    #[col(skip)]
    pub city: String,
    #[col(sortable, filter = date, label = "Placed")]
    pub placed_on: NaiveDate,
    #[col(skip)]
    pub placed_at: i64,
}

/// The orders table: one definition drives the query, the filters with their
/// counts, the drawing and the live refresh.
pub fn orders_table<'a>(
    query: &'a TableQuery<OrderRow>,
    page: &'a TablePage<OrderRow>,
    counts: &[(Status, u64)],
    today: NaiveDate,
) -> DataTable<'a, OrderRow> {
    let statuses = counts
        .iter()
        .map(|(status, n)| FilterOption::new(status.key(), status.label()).count(*n))
        .collect();
    DataTable::new("orders", query, page)
        .caption("Orders")
        .options("status", statuses)
        .cell("number", order_cell)
        .cell("status", |row| status_badge(&row.status))
        .cell("fulfilment", |row| fulfilment_badge(&row.fulfilment))
        .cell("payment", |row| payment_badge(&row.payment))
        .cell("total", total_cell)
        .cell("state", place_cell)
        .cell("placed_on", move |row| {
            Text::new(when(row.placed_at, today)).inline()
        })
        .filter_bar()
        .sticky_header()
        .live_from("/events")
        .live_event("orders")
        .empty(
            Empty::new("No order matches")
                .icon(icons::SEARCH_X)
                .description(
                    "Clear a filter, or search for an order number, a name or an address.",
                ),
        )
}

/// A number of units and a button, in a form of the row's own: the server adds
/// them and the stream redraws the row.
fn restock_cell(row: &ProductRow) -> Node {
    el("form")
        .attr("method", "post")
        .attr("action", format!("/inventory/{}/restock", row.id))
        .flag("data-ui-form", true)
        .uses(Uses::CORE)
        .child(
            Row::gap(2)
                .align(Align::Center)
                .justify(Justify::End)
                .children((
                    Input::number("quantity")
                        .value(row.restock.to_string())
                        .attr("min", 1_i64)
                        .attr("max", RESTOCK_MAX)
                        .attr("aria-label", format!("Units of {} to add", row.name))
                        .required(),
                    Button::outline("Restock")
                        .icon(icons::PACKAGE_PLUS)
                        .size(Size::Sm)
                        .submit(),
                )),
        )
        .into()
}
